wiktionary.gloss: That which persists or remains following the removal or elimination of other elements.

A form of complex number, proportional to the contour integral of a meromorphic function along a path enclosing one of its singularities.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English resignacion, resignacioun, from Old French resignation, from Medieval Latin resignātiōnem, accusative of resignātio. Equivalent to resign + -ation.

senses.definition: The act of officially leaving a job or position.

senses.definition: The feeling of quietly accepting a bad situation because you cannot change it.
